content.value: The first time you open the Passive Tree, you must select a class. Selection grants the class's base attributes and unlocks its configured starting node without spending a point. It also fixes where your connected route begins.
15 Strength, 7 Dexterity, 7 Intelligence. Starts at the Armour route. Best fit for heavy armour, maximum health, and close-range physical weapons.
7 Strength, 15 Dexterity, 7 Intelligence. Starts at Evasion Rating. Best fit for bows, fast attacks, critical strikes, and avoiding entity-sourced hits.
11 Strength, 11 Dexterity, 7 Intelligence. Starts at Armour and Evasion Rating. A physical hybrid suited to swords, spears, crossbows, and mixed defensive bases.
7 Strength, 11 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence. Starts at Energy Shield and Evasion Rating. A mobile hybrid that combines avoidance with a rechargeable buffer.
7 Strength, 7 Dexterity, 15 Intelligence. Starts at Energy Shield. Best fit for mana, elemental damage, ailments, and Intelligence-aligned defence.
11 Strength, 7 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence. Starts at Armour and Energy Shield. A durable hybrid for physical pressure, recovery, and layered mitigation.

Class choice is permanent for that character. The six entries above are the shipped server configuration; a server can edit the class file, so the selection screen is the final authority for that world.
A class is a starting position, not a locked job. Connected routes can eventually travel toward other archetypes if you invest enough points.
